description: The grumpy ogre returns as Shrek deals with impending fatherhood and the call to be King of Far Far Away. Star-studded animated sequel.

title: Wonder Park
description: The story of a magical theme park where the imagination of a little girl named June comes to life. Animated family film with the voices of Mila Kunis and Jennifer Garner.
